style: A finished, professional logo, flat and vector-clean, perfectly symmetrical where it should be, no photo, no texture, no watermark, no extra words, no people.

moments.title: logo-crest
moments.prompt: A LOGO for a basketball game called GAME 7, on a plain dark background, centred, large, nothing else in the frame. The reference image shows the mark the game uses today: an orange basketball carrying a bold white 7, and the wordmark GAME7 with the 7 in orange. Keep that idea - the ball, the 7, the word GAME - and make it a CREST: a shield outline in gold with the ball-and-7 at its heart, GAME 7 lettered across a ribbon beneath, two small stars, clean vector edges, navy, gold and orange. The only text is GAME 7 (or GAME and 7), spelled exactly.
